_note: Classes outside the widget contract. This list may only ever shrink: each batch contractualises some of it. Reseed with --write only when deliberately recording a new baseline.
_unpaintedNote: Contract classes no theme paints, each with the reason it is acceptable. Same rule: may only ever shrink. "unreviewed" means nobody has decided yet — it is a to-do, not a verdict.

_unpainted.mdy-chip-wrapper: the themes paint .mdy-chip; the wrapper is a layout box with no treatment of its own
_unpainted.mdy-colors__dropdown--above: derived by popupPlacementClass/popupAlignmentClass and emitted by the renderers; no theme reacts to it yet. A placement class only earns a rule where the popup has a top/bottom or left/right asymmetry to answer — the select and multiselect flip their search box, a calendar has nothing to flip.

_unpainted.mdy-renderer--select: a root kind marker, not a treatment: the themes reach a select through the parts it declares (.mdy-select__trigger, __arrow, __dropdown), which is where a select's look actually lives. The one rule that used it scoped a caret rotation to focus, which is a state the arrow already declares -- removing it left the marker unused rather than unpainted by oversight.
